item.title: Opinion: Child poverty is deepening in Saskatchewan
item.description: In 2023, 78,050 children under the age of 18 in Saskatchewan were in poverty, a child poverty rate of 27.1 per cent. This is well above Canada’s national child poverty rate of 18.3 per cent and is the highest child poverty rate of all the provinces.
